sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 120 stars, MIT, homepage thurbox.thurbeen.eu, Rust, pushed 2026-11-17.

sources.title: Release v3.5.2 and assets
sources.finding: Latest release v3.5.2 (2026-11-17) with archives for aarch64-apple-darwin, aarch64/x86_64 Linux (musl; gnu x64) and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc plus sha256 sums.

sources.title: README
sources.locator: intro; Use v2 for now; What's new in v3; Install v3; First steps
sources.finding: Terminal workspace running Claude Code, Codex, pi, opencode, kilo, omp, Qwen Code, Copilot CLI and Kimi Code unmodified; sessions outlive the interface; Fleets over ssh/WSL; worktree per session; Lua panes; MIT; v3 not yet fully stable.

sources.title: Where sessions run
sources.locator: Terms; Today and planned; What thurbox does on another machine
sources.finding: Fleets and places (local, ssh, WSL); remote Fleet session panes; diffs and git stats refuse remote sessions; VM runtime planned.

sources.title: Orchestration
sources.locator: Every Task is a session; Driving sessions; Read the state; Recurring work
sources.finding: Tasks created by scripts, agents or timers appear in the list; parent label nests workers under a lead; fleet list/get/apply/send/watch/delete verbs.

sources.title: Agents
sources.locator: bundled harness table; How status works
sources.finding: Nine bundled harness profiles with hooks and screen rules; status working/attention/idle/unknown; new agents are TOML harness profiles.

sources.title: Fleet overview
sources.finding: Declarative engine: Task, TaskConfig, EnvProvider, ChangeRequest, Conversation, Listener, Board, CronTask, plugin kinds; controllers reconcile; compare-and-swap store under a lease.

sources.title: Task resource
sources.finding: Task spec: harness, host, model, configRef, env, pauseAfterMs, brief, amendments, workspace URLs, dispatch, outputs, forge, subscriptions; dispatch false holds the Task.

sources.title: Task controller
sources.locator: Retries and recovery; After a host reboot; Signals; Harness profiles
sources.finding: Bounded retries (3 attempts, 30 s), revive of lost sessions after reboot with the same id and worktree, idle pause/resume, proven-delivery journal, per-harness hooks.

sources.title: CronTask resource
sources.finding: CronTask creates a Task from a template on a cron schedule with concurrencyPolicy, startingDeadlineSeconds and historyLimit.

sources.title: Feature decisions
sources.locator: Scheduling work; Session Lifecycle; Update Notifications; OS Notifications; Parent Sessions
sources.finding: Fleet schedules; version_check and auto_update feature flags on by default; OS notifications; parent label nests children.

sources.title: Forge controller
sources.finding: Workers declare changes with `fleet declare`; ForgeController relays checks, reviews and notes to the Task inbox and can mark a draft ready by policy.

sources.title: ChangeRequest controller
sources.finding: Forge adapters: GitHub via gh, GitLab via glab, Azure DevOps via az, Bitbucket Cloud via curl.

sources.title: Gateway adapters
sources.finding: Slack and Discord adapters (Telegram and Teams mapped on paper only) let a chat thread start and talk to a Task; Fleet holds no credentials.

sources.title: Board resource
sources.finding: Boards are shared event logs that Tasks can subscribe to, with retention limits.

sources.title: Fleet configuration
sources.locator: running fleet up; forge; gateway accounts
sources.finding: fleet init/doctor/up; accounts keep tokens in operator-owned curl config files; Fleet never reads PATs or tokens.

sources.title: Observability
sources.finding: No program has its own telemetry setting; OpenTelemetry export follows standard OTEL_* variables and is off without them.

sources.title: thurbox architecture
sources.finding: Fleet is the engine (ADR-41); the interface reads fleet watch and draws it; Lua panes.

sources.title: runtime-mux
sources.finding: Runtime keeps sessions alive in tmux (psmux on Windows) and makes worktrees through workspace-git.

sources.title: Writing a pane
sources.finding: Panes are Lua files with a sandboxed API exposing sessions, tasks, diffs and links; F10 reloads.

sources.title: thurbox config
sources.finding: settings.toml [features] and [fleets.<name>] with local, ssh and WSL transports.

sources.title: Session diff worker
sources.finding: Per-session diff computed on a background thread via git, capped at 4 MiB and exposed to Lua plugins; there is no bundled diff pane in ui/plugins.

sources.title: Bundled interface plugins
sources.finding: Bundled panes: sessions, agent, confirm, rename, menu, search, new_session.

sources.title: Install script
sources.finding: Downloads release archives and checksums and installs thurbox, thurbox-cli, fleet, runtime-mux and workspace-git.

sources.finding: MIT License.

sources.title: Cargo.toml
sources.finding: Rust workspace with fleet-* crates, runtime-mux, workspace-git, thurbox; MIT.

sources.title: Interface demo animation
sources.finding: First frame: Sessions list (fix-osc52-tmux, perf-session-order-cache, add-wsl-host-tests, docs-remote-hooks), Claude Code pane, Tasks list (3 open) and System CPU/MEM panel.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP and API servers
sources.locator: grep mcp|model context protocol over crates/, ui/, docs/
sources.finding: No MCP server or HTTP API is shipped; the only match is a harness MCP-reload status string.

sources.title: Bounded search: SSO and accounts
sources.finding: No SSO, accounts or multi-user model; matches concern forge organizations only.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost and usage
sources.locator: grep token usage|cost|spend|billing over crates/, docs/
sources.finding: No per-task cost or token accounting; matches are tests and theme code.

sources.title: Bounded search: container and sandbox isolation
sources.finding: No container, VM or OS sandbox for agents; matches are tmux/workspace code and test sandboxes; VM runtime is planned only.

sources.title: Bounded search: web and mobile clients
sources.locator: grep web ui|browser client|http server|ios|android over crates/, website/
sources.finding: No web client or phone app; the interface is a terminal UI (website is documentation).

sources.title: Bounded search: issue tracker, specs, memory
sources.locator: grep issue tracker|linear|jira|spec-driven|memory over crates/, docs/
sources.finding: No issue tracker integration or spec feature; the demo Tasks pane is not among the seven bundled panes.

sources.title: README: Use v2 for now
sources.locator: section 'Use v2 for now' and 'Install v3 (not yet recommended)'
sources.finding: After the v3.5.2 tag the README states that the maintainers recommend thurbox v2 (v2.89.0) over v3 for now because v3 is not yet fully stable. The README at the pinned v3.5.2 commit 67bec8c does not contain this notice.
